title: Computer Networks Laboratory
objectives:
The objective of this lab course is to get practical knowledge of the working principles of various
communication protocols. Analyse structure and formats of TCP/IP layer protocols using network
tools such as Wireshark and network simulators.
textbooks:
1. J. F. Kurose, Keith W. Ross, Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach, 7th Edition,
Pearson, 2016
